The attached image is the CURRENT low-detail version of this character, drawn by our game engine. Redraw THIS SAME character as premium hand-painted artwork: keep the same face, hair, outfit, colors, props and proportions, and the same cheerful look, but with real painted quality.

Character: TYRUS, a sporty 7-year-old tennis kid, chibi (about 3 and a half heads tall), athletic and confident. Messy brown hair held back by a red sweatband, bright brown eyes, an eager grin. Outfit: teal sports jersey with a white V-neck and white side stripes and a white number 1 on the chest, white tennis shorts, red wristbands, white socks and teal-and-white sneakers. He holds a red tennis racket with white strings in his right hand, racket pointing down and slightly forward.
